look_here_first: Narrow-leaved purple ironweed of dry rocky sites: linear leaves with densely woolly lower surfaces, usually glabrate upper surfaces, and strongly revolute margins.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: dry rocky-site ironweed; linear cauline leaves; lower leaf surfaces densely sericeo-tomentose; upper surfaces usually glabrate; strongly revolute leaf margins; purple discoid heads in corymbiform arrays

key_traits.label: Comparison training
key_traits.text: Much narrower-leaved than V. baldwinii; watch for intermediate V. × guadalupensis.

lookalikes.differences: Linear revolute leaves with woolly undersides strongly favor V. lindheimeri; intermediates may be hybrid.
